inputs.text: Just came across details on this lawsuit pushing back against ICE for detaining thousands of people right as they leave immigration courts. This is a necessary challenge to the agency's overreach and discriminatory practices that disproportionately harm vulnerable immigrant communities and families. Court documents make clear that ICE was relying on a memo from May of last year which gave no authorization for these detentions, highlighting how such actions stem from structural inequalities and institutional efforts to target marginalized groups. These kinds of legal actions are essential for advancing social justice, protecting labor rights and human dignity, and forcing reforms to end the exploitation rooted in our broken immigration system.
